article.title: Tim Harford’s chapter eight, a contribution from Sahar Akhtar
article.excerpt: Harford writes that voters aren’t fooled into thinking their votes affect the outcome and that most people vote because it makes them feel good. These ‘expressive’ explanations help us preserve the idea that people are rational (a great book is by Brennan and Lomasky ). But is this an actual account of why people vote?
